synthesis.body: A green `make build-check` is not a green CI. The CI job named "make build-check" runs the make target AND additional steps in the same job, and the repo-root `tests/roster/` suite is reachable only from `make ci` — build-check prints a "complete" banner without it. Run `make ci` before pushing any change that bumps a version or edits a changelog, not just build-check. The trap that surfaced this: tests/roster/test_workspace_status_projection.py asserts the agentbundle version in pyproject.toml, CLI_VERSION in version.py, a matching `## [x.y.z]` heading in packages/agentbundle/CHANGELOG.md, and the FIRST `### [agentbundle][x.y.z]` heading in docs/product/changelog.md all agree. Filing release notes under [Unreleased] instead of a versioned `### [agentbundle][x.y.z]` section fails it.

title: Local make build-check does not run what CI build-check runs
